headline: Nikkei 225 Tops 69,000 as Trump Announces Iran Deal
summary: The Nikkei 225 closed above 69,000 for the first time on Monday, rising 4.99% to 69,317.50. Trump said a deal had been reached to end the conflict between the United States and Iran.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, tracking large Tokyo-listed companies and reflecting sentiment on the Japanese economy.
